notes.text: The Bavli identifies Yehudah the baker in the marriage settlement case. This locus does not narrate his execution. The exact reciprocal gives the joint execution in Heilprin and explicitly cites the Yalkut. Direct Yalkut collation is still needed. The checked Yerushalmi names Yehudah the baker, with his tongue in a dog’s mouth. Preserve Heilprin’s refuse heap as a distinct detail. The checked Bavli names Chutzpit and describes a pig dragging the tongue. Neither identification should displace the other. The exact reciprocal identifies the paired teaching by Yehudah the baker and Yosi bar Yasin in Menachot. The terse conjunction remains in the received prose. Recanati Vayechi directly reads לשונו where Heilprin gives defective לשוט. It is a verbal parallel and does not verify Heilprin’s exact Yalkut Reuveni location. The Bavli explicitly pairs Yehudah the baker with Yose ben Yose ben Yassayan in the checked text. Retain Heilprin’s shortened name.
